gloss: to show frustration; to be visibly upset (about a loss or failure)

definitions.gloss: to show frustration; to be visibly upset; to express vexation
definitions.explanation: To outwardly display feelings of frustration, regret, or bitterness, especially after a loss or missed opportunity. Formed from {悔|くや}しい (frustrating) + the suffix ～がる (to show signs of).

examples.japanese: ⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧{悔|くや}しがった。
examples.english: They were visibly frustrated at losing.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悔|くや}しがって⟦{泣|な}いている→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: The child is crying out of frustration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悔|くや}しがる⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the sight of the player showing frustration after the loss.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧ (frustrating, vexing) + the suffix ～⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧, which converts an adjective describing internal feelings into a verb describing the outward display of those feelings.

THE ～がる PATTERN:
Japanese い-adjectives describing emotions (like ⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧, ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧, ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧) directly describe the speaker's own feelings. To describe someone else showing those feelings, add ～⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧:
- ⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧ → {悔|くや}しがる: to show frustration
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧ → {嬉|うれ}し⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to show happiness
- ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧ → {怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to show fear
- ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧ → {寂|さび}し⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to show loneliness

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧{悔|くや}しがる: to be frustrated at losing
- ⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{悔|くや}しがる: to be deeply frustrated
- {悔|くや}しがる⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧: a frustrated demeanor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧: frustrating — the base adjective describing the feeling itself
- ⟦{悔|く}やむ→悔やむ：14725_kuyamu⟧: to regret — focuses on remorse over a past action
- ⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to express disappointment — milder and less bitter
